description: Ember Trace is a two-person geospatial AI team from Brazil. Isabella Subtil Norberto (PhD candidate, UNESP; Visiting Researcher, FGI) works on AI and photogrammetry, building 3D multispectral point clouds from LiDAR. Clodoaldo Júnior (PhD candidate, ITA; ex-geospatial data scientist) works on AI and remote sensing, using deep learning for satellite positioning. Together we test whether trends in Brazil’s fire-season climate and fires are real or just noise.
